_comment: What the in-app update prompt says, keyed by version. Keep each list to three short lines: this is read on a phone, standing up.
0.14.0: An owner console, in the app: every account, Pro access, pausing someone, and a record of every change.
Every button answers on the first touch now — spring presses, content that arrives, segments that slide.
Four new colours — sage, plum, clay and lagoon — so the app is no longer just teal and beige.
0.13.3: The ad button can no longer get stuck: after 20 seconds the tools open anyway.
Owner screen: a reset for the 48-hour unlock, so the ad card can be tested again.
0.13.2: Watching an ad now actually waits for the ad library to start, instead of racing it.
If no ad can be shown, the card says why and opens the tools for 48 hours anyway.
Owner screen: a new button plays Google's test ad, to prove the code works.
0.13.1: Fixes the crash on opening. The build was shrinking code and cutting out a piece the app needs at startup.
Ads stay on: one ad opens the 11 extra PDF tools for 48 hours, everyday tools stay free.
If an ad can't load you get the 48 hours anyway.
0.13.0: Ads are back — one ad opens the 11 extra PDF tools for 48 hours.
The everyday tools stay free, and nothing is ever locked behind a banner.
If an ad can't load, you get the 48 hours anyway.
0.12.1: The app opens again. The ad code is out of this build completely — that is what was closing it.
Every tool works, and every tool is free while ads are off.
If it ever crashes, a report is saved to your Downloads folder so it can be fixed properly.
0.12.0: The app stops closing. Ads now come from a small module of our own instead of the library that crashed it.
Ads are back on: one ad opens the 11 extra PDF tools for 48 hours, and the everyday tools stay free.
Focus Mode, updates and your settings are untouched.
0.11.2: Opening PDF Arena no longer closes the app. The ad software is fully switched off until that is fixed.
Every tool is free while ads are paused — nothing is locked, nothing asks for anything.
Focus Mode, updates and your settings are untouched.
0.11.1: Fixes the app closing the moment you opened it. The ad software is switched off in this build while that is sorted.
Everything else stays: Focus Mode, all 21 PDF tools, and nothing is locked while ads are paused.
Your settings carry across — nothing to re-enter, nothing to reinstall twice.
0.11.0: Regain is now Focus Mode. Same feature, same rules, and your settings come across on their own.
Android ties the accessibility permission to the feature's name, so turn Focus Mode on once more in Settings → Accessibility.
Real ads are live, and they only ever appear in PDF Arena when you choose one.
0.10.0: 11 extra PDF tools — protect, watermark, compare, repair — open for 48 hours after one short ad.
Everyday tools stay free: merge, split, sign, rotate, compress and the rest never ask.
No ads in Focus Mode, and no banners anywhere. One ad, only when you choose it.
0.9.5: Signing: the ink shows on the page while you place it, in a frame you can drag.
The lite edition now updates to the lite edition — never back to the build with Focus Mode.
PDF Arena unchanged otherwise: 21 tools, results saved to Downloads, one-tap updates.
0.9.4: Signing: the ink now shows on the page while you place it, in a frame you can drag.
The signature in the card on the tool screen is visible too, instead of a white box.
Everything else is unchanged: 21 PDF tools, results saved to Downloads, one-tap updates.
0.9.3: A "lite" edition of the app now installs with no security prompt at all — it leaves Focus Mode out.
The full app still has Focus Mode; Play Protect blocks it until you switch scanning off once.
Updates: the prompt picks the package built for your phone and checks it arrived intact.
0.9.2: The update prompt now picks the package built for your phone — about half the size.
The app updates itself in one tap, and checks the file arrived intact first.
PDF Arena: sign, place, and every result lands in your Downloads folder.
0.9.1: Installs are now checked against the file's fingerprint, so a broken download says so instead of failing at Android.
The app shows what is new, then updates itself in one tap.
PDF Arena: sign, place, and every result lands in your Downloads folder.
0.9.0: Updates now install from inside the app — no browser, no hunting for a file.
A prompt at launch shows what changed, with five seconds before Update unlocks.
PDF Arena: sign with your finger or a photo, then drag and pinch it into place.
